Fibonacci.source:
; prints Fibonacci numbers until the next one no longer fits in 8 bits
loop:   LDA x
        OUT
        ADD y        ; A = x + y
        JC done      ; carry: the sum passed 255
        STA t
        LDA y
        STA x
        LDA t
        STA y
        JMP loop
done:   HLT
x:      .byte 0
y:      .byte 1
t:      .byte 0

Multiply.source:
; 7 x 6 by adding 7 six times
loop:   LDA prod
        ADD x
        STA prod
        LDA cnt
        SUB one
        STA cnt
        JZ done
        JMP loop
done:   LDA prod
        OUT
        HLT
prod:   .byte 0
x:      .byte 7
cnt:    .byte 6
one:    .byte 1

Countdown.source:
; counts 10 down to 0
loop:   LDA n
        OUT
        SUB one      ; sets Z when n reaches 0
        STA n
        JZ done
        JMP loop
done:   LDA n
        OUT
        HLT
n:      .byte 10
one:    .byte 1

XOR from NAND.source:
; x XOR y built from four NANDs (the CPU has no XOR instruction)
        LDA x
        NAND y       ; n = NAND(x, y)
        STA n
        NAND x       ; p = NAND(n, x)
        STA p
        LDA n
        NAND y       ; NAND(n, y)
        NAND p       ; NAND(NAND(n, y), p) = x XOR y
        OUT
        HLT
x:      .byte 0b11001010
y:      .byte 0b10100110
n:      .byte 0
p:      .byte 0
